## Problem and architecture decision

The #5095 owned-manifest path removes repeated directory scans, but the allocator still serializes a fourteen-nibble unary chain and leaf wrapper. At the clean component head b3eb3e4d55289f5681c6a50d27422d938f8f380d, a single dirty chunk requires sixteen state pages before its reservation/header. Private first-write reuse (#5105) and detached index descriptions (#5103) reduce heap work without removing those physical identities.

The source-bound ACK-only diagnostic retains all ten full public oracles. Whole-call median ratio is1.03861, allocation bytes0.83191 and objects0.93159; foreground tail noise remains rejected. This does not identify an exclusive cause or qualify #5095: https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5095#issuecomment-6048997738. Ordinary manifest staging already joins the existing finalization; a second per-ACK manifest publication is not supported by the inspected caller.

Select a **conditional implementation of one canonical compressed sixteen-way Patricia allocator tree**, shared by mutable ownership and physical encoding. A chunk is a direct leaf, without an index wrapper. A branch carries an explicit nibble depth/common prefix, fixed ordered child slots and summaries, and has at least two children. Insert splits at the first differing nibble; removing empty chunks collapses unary branches. Empty state retains one exact-generation sentinel; an unchanged direct-leaf root still receives its required exact-generation rewrite. Consolidate the existing allocator implementation instead of adding an expanded shadow tree, physical-only skip translation, alternate allocator, registry or global pool.

## Deliverable, dependency and ownership

Primary deliverable: one complete implementation **PR**, permitted to land atomically with #5103/#5105/#5095. Acceptance owner: #5090 coordinator. Consume accepted #5091 and landed #5101, plus the exact b3eb component contract. This is a necessary blocking successor of the existing representation components and predecessor of #5095 final qualification; it does not complete the parent by itself.

The new format intentionally replaces the old physical representation. Existing #5105 identical-v1-page/CRC/ID evidence remains a historical component oracle. This child replaces that representation oracle with independent logical allocation/retirement/reservation/recovery equivalence and canonical new-format byte/count validation. It does not waive rollback, candidate isolation, pin/reuse horizons, append burns or any parent capacity/performance gate.

Owned seams at that head: generation_v1_tree.go, state_operation_v1.go, intrinsic_tree_credit_v1.go, generation_v1_txn.go, generation_v1_format.go, generation_v1_reservation.go, generation_v1_metadata_reuse.go, generation_v1_prune_bounded.go, allocator_cow.go, owned_generation_handle_v1.go, allocation_credit_v1.go and resident_attachment_v1.go, plus their affected DB integration tests/docs. Native #5093/#5094 consumes the recomputed allocator inventory; coordinate that interface before composition. #5098 cached producer handoff remains separately owned. Broad #5044 and external #5015/#5016/PR#5037 retain their owners and scope; this ticket grants no takeover.

Production route: public CheckpointOwnedLeafManifest/ordinary durable finalization → existing owned manifest staging → queued visible allocator preparation and separate publisher seal, or ordinary durable candidate → shared COW allocator materialization → existing root-record/meta recovery. Preserve both real visible/seal generations and their independently captured horizons.

## Discriminating evidence and test-first start

The root independently verified twenty actual source files against b3eb Git bytes and reran the source-bound advisory oracle. A separate adjacent-pair versus recursive-prefix model checked1000 topology/mutation cases and1000 reservation conflict cases. Conditional one-reservation-page counts are18→3 total pages for one dirty chunk and20→5 for two adjacent dirty chunks. These are model counts, not actual emitted-page or latency claims.

Source packets on185:
- notes/L-physical-topology-adviser-v1.md SHAd986e727adec6463101adc934625255ebb9a3926b5433a8868740af171115fae; source binding33a543f240184b2664cd41a53481938742c9572b47d01b57c614d0aed0c77d48.
- artifacts/5095/L-physical-topology-count-oracle-v2/receipt.json SHAed16a507c9b88909de59f6dab96e1e0f71e494d95f09bfe495220cdc6a81c99f.
- artifacts/5095/L-physical-topology-root-discriminator-v4/count_oracle.py SHAa92e281f83c8da32588b7d9d4bffd546842146ea28d2229298c80a00ead92862; result SHAe50d1ceaa9ce7ca9674843dee9eff865fa7cf0e6f2c94e83482334a867294b34.
- notes/L-reservation-count-caveat-v1.md SHA04d76ac6fc3a86b3b8178e14f996badd686a32b00d42bd45094f57332fee3fb9.

Start with meaningful red state-page/count and format/reopen invariants. The reservation oracle also exposes a helper mismatch: an E162 normalized base ending in an adjacent abandoned extent plus one skipped page forecasts164 entries/R2, but append-coalesced assembly has163/R1. Actual transaction reachability is not yet proved. Characterize it on the real materializer, then preserve or repair reservation/emission agreement; do not treat a conservative count as exact encoded cardinality.

## Complete implementation and acceptance packet

- [ ] Lookup, nearest-free/locality search, ordered walk, mutation, prune cursor and summaries all use the same canonical prefix/depth topology. No unary branch or empty descendant survives. Independent reference state agrees for empty, single, adjacent, sparse/high-bit, insert/split, delete/collapse, mixed dirty/durable and repeated mutations.
- [ ] Version the on-disk topology explicitly. Fresh stores select the new format; unsupported/old binaries and old directories fail closed under the pre-alpha rebuild policy, using the existing format/required-feature mechanism where applicable. No migration scaffolding or silent interpretation of old depth+1 bytes.
- [ ] Loader checks canonical first-difference prefix/depth, increasing depth, at least two children, ordered unique slots, typed child identity, exact chunk key, summaries, parent generation/checksum, root type/exact generation, full zero tails/CRC, highwater and duplicate/cycle/alias identities including header/reservation pages. Add malformed/torn/missing/aliased fixtures and reopen/fallback/crash tests for both durable slots and held readers.
- [ ] Private copy/split/collapse retains every surviving edge exactly once, scrubs detached references and releases actual full creator-owned classes at the last edge. Rollback bases, retained views and generic retaining/mutating sinks stay isolated. Allocation plans precede every birth/growth, include overlap, and recompute actual branch/chunk/plan/output/resident classes rather than inherit the208-byte node claim.
- [ ] Actual visible and seal candidates each reconcile counted, reserved, emitted and retired physical IDs after their own data/prune/auxiliary edits. Cover reservation163-entry boundaries, coalescing, skipped conflict/burn ranges and reused metadata. Deduplicate old identities; keep atomic claims and the bounded four-chunk reuse policy. Preserve strict metadata count<freeCount or recompute final collapsed topology before claiming.
- [ ] Keep all existing finite numeric gates: P8192, Q237942, F32, V64, metadata128MiB and the accepted publisher reserve. Prune stays within512 nodes/64 entries/16 promotions. Recompute actual byte/class witnesses and full callers; finite routing remains closed until the whole birth/lifetime certificate passes.
- [ ] Focused normal/race, broader affected allocator/publication/recovery/pin/GC/fault suites, independent review and exact-head required CI pass. Update storage-format.md, recovery.md, write-path-and-durability.md, recoverable-root-set-maintenance-3681.md, concurrency-paradigms.md, verification.md and affected typed-storage performance/lifecycle guidance in the same packet.
- [ ] This is performance-objective work. Compare exact source/compiled-input/binary-frozen b3eb versus the candidate with equivalent public workloads and separate setup/ACK/GC boundaries. Report actual pages/COW bytes, branch/chunk copies, allocation bytes/objects, retained/peak memory, per-phase visible/seal work, storage and foreground median/p95/p99. Frozen five-pair CV≤.10 and spread≤.15 policy and all #5091/#5095 numerical/foreground/storage targets remain unchanged. Helper page counts alone cannot qualify it.

## Reassessment and failure action

Before runtime activation, reject any design that cannot provide canonical loader, rollback/ownership, reservation/emission or unchanged capacity proof. Once those pass, run the bounded public discriminator before broad qualification. If pages fall without sufficient public improvement, retain the negative/noisy packet and revise the remaining architecture; do not close #5095 or invent a cap increase, accepted residual, reduced fixture or fused generation. Full #5096/#5097 qualification remains required.


## Constructor prerequisite selected — 2026-10-08, 08:28 UTC

Required final acceptance/merge prerequisite: [#5113](https://github.com/snissn/gomap/issues/5113), the same-Pager constructor resident account, complete shared loans, pre-WAL capacity envelope and joined teardown. The historical Pager is born before the former first-request master, so attaching a request factory cannot certify its backing. Component construction can continue provisionally; full finite/native admission and this node's final runtime acceptance require #5113 accepted and merged with actual producer/retained-lifetime census and unchanged whole128MiB fit. No larger cap, default change, first-request reattribution, second budget/registry or external unfrozen ABI.
title: [R1 architecture] Replace unary allocator metadata chains with one canonical compressed topology
